##### Random Network FFRCISTG

The random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (RNFFRCISTG) is a causal model defined by the independence assumptions of: i) random network interference, and ii) no contagion, and the homogeneity assumptions of iii) homogeneous random network interference with respect to the included random graphs, iv) identical structural distributions, together with single-world independence over the structural variables and relational error terms independent of the structural ones (@def-rnffrcitg).
